outcomes.text: 18,000 people screaming. Your ex leaves the live. Blessing goes quiet, then shy, which is new.

choices.label: Pay the tab. Walk out the front door.

outcomes.text: The bouncer accepts it with deep spiritual disappointment.

choices.receipt: You hid in the club toilet during the raid.

outcomes.text: Forty minutes on a toilet seat on Ozumba Mbadiwe. Blessing finds you: 'You hid? From police? Where your Warri spirit?'

choices.label: [Big Boy] Pay, then post 'I run this city'.
choices.receipt: You paid the raid tab and posted 'I run this city'.

outcomes.text: 500k views. Kayode reposts. Blessing books you as 'special guest' for her next event.

beats.text: Thursday, 4am. A studio above a shop in Yaba. You came with pepper soup. Blessing opens the door in the hoodie. Behind her, Jiro, shirtless.
Ah. The sponsor. Come in, the soup will get cold.
{tell}

dj_ex.text: Her phone in her hand shows an Uber she cancelled at 11pm. She was always staying.

choices.label: Hand Jiro the soup. Walk away.
choices.receipt: You handed the DJ your pepper soup and walked away.

outcomes.text: You walk down the stairs into Yaba at 4am. A danfo conductor shouts 'Oyingbo!' You get in. You don't know where Oyingbo is. Freedom.

choices.label: "Blessing. Him or me. Now."
choices.receipt: You made Blessing choose between you and the DJ.

outcomes.text: She looks at Jiro for a long time. Then pulls off the hoodie and throws it at him. 'Me. I choose me. And you.'
'Babe, it's complicated.' It's not. You leave the soup.

choices.label: Go live from the doorway.
choices.receipt: You went live from the DJ's studio doorway.

outcomes.text: 'Warri's biggest promoter, caught at 4am.' The whole of Lagos nightlife is watching before Jiro finds a shirt.

choices.label: "I'll pretend I didn't see. Eat the soup."
choices.receipt: You pretended not to see and ate pepper soup with them.

outcomes.text: Three of you eat pepper soup in silence. She holds your hand under the table. Jiro holds her other one.

choices.label: "Jiro. My silence costs ₦1m."
choices.receipt: You charged the DJ for your silence.

outcomes.text: Jiro laughs. Then he sees your face. ₦1m arrives from a promoter's account. 'Tell nobody.'

choices.label: "Old merch you only sleep in, abi?"
choices.receipt: You quoted her 'old merch' line in the studio doorway.

outcomes.text: She looks down at the hoodie. Then at you. 'I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.' For once, she has no comeback.

choices.label: "Recording drops till 4am. Every Thursday."
choices.receipt: You quoted her 'recording drops on Thursdays' line.

outcomes.text: Jiro laughs: 'Drops? Is that what she calls it?' Blessing slaps his arm. Nobody laughs after that.

choices.label: Call Ese on speaker.
choices.receipt: You called Ese on speaker from the studio.

outcomes.text: Ese: 'Blessing. I told you. I told you this would happen.' Ese is now on your side, permanently.

Babe, no look the invoice. Look the crowd. We did this!
{tell}

event_money.text: The invoice is addressed to you. The flyer named you sponsor. Ese says that's 'a vibe, not a contract'. Probably.

choices.label: Pay a chunk. Event night is sacred.
choices.receipt: You paid part of the vendor's invoice on event night.

outcomes.text: The vendor bows. Blessing kisses you on stage. You funded a party you didn't know you were throwing.

choices.label: "Where's my refund, Blessing?"
choices.receipt: You asked Blessing for your refund in the middle of her event.

outcomes.text: She shows you the gate takings: ₦3.1m. 'Okay. Okay. Here.' ₦500k. She'd never planned to.

choices.label: Grab the mic. Tell the crowd who really paid.
choices.receipt: You told her whole event who really paid.

outcomes.text: 1,200 people hear it. The DJ drops a siren effect. Blessing's career flatlines on live video.

choices.label: "Make me a real partner. 40% of the door."
choices.receipt: You demanded 40% of the door as a real partner.

outcomes.text: She thinks. Then shakes on it. 'Business and pleasure. Separate accounts.' ₦800k by sunrise.

choices.label: Leave the invoice on the bar. Walk.
choices.receipt: You left the invoice on the bar and walked out.

outcomes.text: Ozumba Mbadiwe at 3am. The bass follows you to the junction. Then it doesn't.

choices.label: "It's Monday, Blessing. Refund."
choices.receipt: You told Blessing it was finally Monday.

outcomes.text: She laughs, then sees your face. ₦300k, right there. 'I hate that you remember things.'

choices.label: "I funded this. Show me the books."
choices.receipt: You asked to see the books for the events you funded.

outcomes.text: Ese opens a spreadsheet. Your money is in every row. Next to 'Blessing - hair', 'Blessing - Dubai'.

choices.label: "Did any of it reach Mama?"
choices.receipt: You asked if any of your money reached her mama.

outcomes.text: She goes quiet. 'Some. Not enough.' Then she cries, which you did not expect, in the middle of her own event.

beats.text: Jiro grabs the mic at her event: 'Blessing's new person is a fraud. Ask them about their ex.' Two hundred heads turn to you.
Jiro. Come down from that booth. Now.
{tell}

fierce_loyal.text: She holds up her phone to the crowd: 47 missed calls from Jiro. 'This is who's talking.'

choices.label: Let her handle it. Watch her work.
choices.receipt: You let Blessing handle the DJ.

outcomes.text: She takes the mic and ends Jiro's career in four sentences. Then: 'My person, come here.' The crowd cheers you up the steps.

choices.label: "Let's just go. He's not worth your event."
choices.receipt: You asked Blessing to leave her own event with you.

outcomes.text: She hands the mic to Ese and walks out with you. Her own event. 'Nothing is worth you.'

choices.label: "Is he lying, Blessing? Tell me now."
choices.receipt: You asked Blessing, in front of the DJ, if he was lying.

outcomes.text: 'You're asking me? In front of him?' She answers anyway: 'He's lying.' Something small cracks.

choices.label: Climb into the booth. Fight Jiro yourself.
choices.receipt: You climbed into the booth to fight the DJ.

outcomes.text: You swing. You miss. The video is everywhere. Blessing pulls you out: 'I had it! I HAD IT!'

choices.label: Leave. This is too much drama for you.
choices.receipt: You left Blessing's event during the DJ drama.

outcomes.text: You leave. Behind you, she's still defending your name to a man with a microphone. She'll never know you didn't stay to hear it.

choices.label: "After this, pepper soup. My treat."
choices.receipt: You promised Blessing pepper soup mid-showdown.

outcomes.text: She laughs mid-war. 'You remember?' She drops the mic. Literally. It's the loudest thing all night.

choices.label: Text Ese: "Cut the DJ's sound."
choices.receipt: You got Ese to cut the DJ's sound.

outcomes.text: The music dies. Jiro is shouting into a dead mic. Blessing looks at you: 'You and Ese? Planning things? I love it.'

beats.text: Monday. Refund day. Your phone is face up on the table like a court exhibit.
Babe I dey come. Check your account in five minutes.

choices.label: Check your account. Hope.
choices.receipt: You checked your account for Blessing's refund.

outcomes.text: Nothing. Then nothing. Then a sticker of a praying cat.

event_money.text: Nothing. Then: 'Next Monday for real. The event didn't break even.' It sold out.

fierce_loyal.text: All of it, plus 10% and a voice note: 'Interest for trusting a Warri babe. Na so we dey do.'

fierce_loyal.text: She refunds it anyway. 'Love is not a loan, my dear.'

Good morning. You're the sponsor on Blessing's flyer? Sound, lights and small chops balance: ₦480k.

choices.label: Pay something. Your name is on it.
choices.receipt: You paid one of Blessing's vendors because your name was on the flyer.

choices.label: "Call Blessing. I'm just a guest."

outcomes.text: The vendor hangs up. Two minutes later Blessing texts: 'I've handled it. Sorry babe.'

dj_ex.text: 'She said call you or call Jiro. Jiro isn't picking.' Why would Jiro be the other option?

fierce_loyal.text: Ten minutes later, Blessing on the vendor's line, in full Warri: 'Who give you my person's number?' The vendors stop calling forever.

choices.label: Block every unknown number.
choices.receipt: You blocked every unknown number on your phone.

outcomes.text: Peace. Also, your mum couldn't reach you all day. She's furious.

beats.text: Her story, 6am: your pot of pepper soup on top of a speaker. Caption: 'Some people bring flowers. Mine brought catfish. Warri approved.'
My girls are jealous. Mama wants your number. Wetin you do me?

choices.label: "Give Mama my number."
choices.receipt: You asked to meet her mama by phone.

outcomes.text: Mama calls at 6:15am and prays for you in Urhobo for seven minutes. You feel blessed, specifically.

dj_ex.text: Mama calls: 'Are you the one with soup? Not Ejiro?' Blessing grabs the phone back very fast.

choices.label: Repost it: 'My promoter, my problem'.
choices.receipt: You reposted Blessing's pepper soup story.

outcomes.text: Her followers find you. 'Soup bae' trends in her comments. You're now a Lagos nightlife meme.

choices.label: Order another pot for her crew.
choices.receipt: You sent her whole crew pepper soup.

outcomes.text: The crew sends a group voice note: 'WE LOVE YOU'. Blessing: 'You're stealing my people.'

You filmed me? Instead of holding me back? Explain yourself.

choices.receipt: You told Blessing she should thank you for going viral.
